summary: Evaxion A/S filed a Form 6-K reporting an at-the-market offering of 681,268 American Depositary Shares at an average price of USD $3.1987 per ADS, raising net proceeds of $2,113,767 under a Capital Demand Sales Agreement with Jones Trading Institutional Services LLC dated October 3, 2022. The issuance increased share capital to nominal DKK 112,768,539. The filing also includes amended Articles of Association reflecting the capital increase. This is a routine capital raise under existing ATM facility, not a special situation such as a tender offer, restructuring, or activist campaign. No deal terms apply beyond the ordinary equity sale.
